headline: Palantine Berm And Callahan's Passage Churn Under Heavy Northern Assaults
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, combat has intensified sharply across Palantine Berm and Callahan's Passage, both sustaining rapid base turnover and heavy engagements into the latest hours. Palantine Berm stands as the frontline's fiercest sector, recording four base shifts in the past two hours amid persistent clashes at Leiri Hermanni and Windburn Landing. Callahan's Passage maintained heavy structural friction, logging fresh changes at The Crumbling Passage and Crumbling Post alongside hundreds of recent casualties. In Mooring County, combat activity surged violently, generating more than 1,700 casualties in the last two hours alone as forces contend over The Wind Hills. Conversely, Kuura Strand has abruptly quieted down following its earlier upheaval, reporting negligible combat in the latest watch. Broad contested sectors across Nevish Line, Stlican Shelf, and Weathered Expanse continue to register substantial manpower drains despite slowing base conversions, while the southern expanse remains quiet under uninterrupted Colonial command.
